bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 127 (Friday, August 2, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. WATERS:
H.R. 9303.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Clause 3 of Section 8 of Article I of the Constitution,
which provides Congress with the power to ``regulate commerce
with foreign nations, and among the several states, and with
the Indian tribes.''
The single subject of this legislation is:
The bill modifies the Electronic Fund Transfer Act to
improve consumer protections relating to payments.
[Page H4975]
